notes: v1.0.68 - GC chosen from real measured data + chunk-storm detector finally fires on RTP teleports + FPS Boost 1.0.23: analysis of 379 real PROF windows found the JVM GC was the #1 gameplay stutter source (G1 burned up to 2.8s of a 10s window with 100-137ms pauses on the 4-thread iGPU laptop) - potato/turbo tiers and balanced-on-low-core machines now launch with ParallelGC (no concurrent marking phase stealing cores from game + integrated server, GC threads capped 2-3); strong machines keep G1 unchanged, balanced G1 gets 1MB regions + earlier mixed-GC start. The chunk stabilizer never detected RTP/teleport storms (it required 5 CONSECUTIVE slow frames, but a single 1.7s meshing hitch is one slow frame followed by fast catch-up frames - zero S correlation in 379 windows): replaced with an exponentially decaying pressure gauge (intermittent slow frames tolerated, >=400ms hitches nudged hard, threshold at 50ms so sustained 29-32fps shader sessions are not a storm). Both JVM flag sets smoke-tested on Java 25.
